title: 航空機の原理
subtitle: Principle of Aircraft
teachers:
MORIYOSHI Takahiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: An aircraft and its components are designed by combining knowledge of engineering fields such as aerodynamics, structure, engine and control. In order to begin studying in specialized fields, it is important to know the relationship between what is learned in each field and the aircraft. In this course, students will learn how the mechanical elements of aircraft relate to mechanisms and principles through lectures and practical training.
advice:
This course includes lectures and practical training.
In lectures, students will learn aerodynamic forces acting on aircraft, aircraft flight stability, aircraft structural configurations and materials, and aircraft engines without using mathematical formulas nor technical drawings. Moreover, students will also learn the names and outlines of the major subjects in the department of aeronautics which deal with each engineering field.
In practical training, students will learn the basic mechanisms and operating principles of airspeed gauges of aircraft through disassembling and assembling them.
requiredKnowledge: Since this subject is an introductory subject in the curriculum of the department of aeronautics, this subject requires no prior knowledge nor skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain how the aircraft wing generates the lift.
Be able to explain aircraft static flight stability, especially pitch static stability.
Be able to explain the types of aircraft materials and their mechanical properties.
Be able to explain the types of aircraft engines and their major components.
Be able explain the relationships between the major subjects of department of aeronautics.
Be able to understand how the aircraft airspeed gauge operates while disassembling and assembling it.

              An aircraft and its components are designed by combining knowledge of engineering fields such as aerodynamics, structure, engine and control. In order to begin studying in specialized fields, it is important to know the relationship between what is learned in each field and the aircraft. In this course, students will learn how the mechanical elements of aircraft relate to mechanisms and principles through lectures and practical training.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course includes lectures and practical training.
In lectures, students will learn aerodynamic forces acting on aircraft, aircraft flight stability, aircraft structural configurations and materials, and aircraft engines without using mathematical formulas nor technical drawings. Moreover, students will also learn the names and outlines of the major subjects in the department of aeronautics which deal with each engineering field.
In practical training, students will learn the basic mechanisms and operating principles of airspeed gauges of aircraft through disassembling and assembling them.
